sql:
SELECT COUNT(s.NCESSchool)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Charter' AND ss.AvgScrMath > 560;

SELECT COUNT(s.NCESSchool) AS CharterSchoolCount
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Charter' AND ss.AvgScrMath > 560;

SELECT COUNT(s.NCESSchool) AS NumberOfCharterSchools
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Charter' AND ss.AvgScrMath > 560;

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode) 
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
WHERE st.AvgScrMath > 560 AND s.FundingType = 'Direct';

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
WHERE st.AvgScrMath > 560 AND s.FundingType = 'Direct Charter';

SELECT COUNT(T2.CDSCode) 
FROM satscores AS T1 
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T1.AvgScrMath > 560 AND T2.FundingType = 'Direct Charter';

SELECT COUNT(schools.NCESSchool)
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE AVG(satscores.AvgScrMath) > 560 AND schools.FundingType = 'Charter';

SELECT COUNT(schools.NCESSchool)
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE AVG(satscores.AvgScrMath) > 560 AND schools.FundingType = 'Charter';

SELECT COUNT(s.NCESSchool)
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY cds
    HAVING AVG(AvgScrMath) > 560
) ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Charter';

SELECT COUNT(s.NCESSchool)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE AVG(ss.AvgScrMath) > 560 AND s.FundingType = 'Charter';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.NCESSchool)
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE AVG(T2.AvgScrMath) > 560 AND T1.FundingType LIKE '%charter%'

SELECT COUNT(s.NCESSchool)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE AVG(ss.AvgScrMath) > 560 AND s.FundingType = 'Charter';

SELECT COUNT(s.NCESSchool)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Charter' AND AVG(ss.AvgScrMath) > 560;

SELECT COUNT(s.NCESSchool)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Charter'
GROUP BY s.NCESSchool
HAVING AVG(ss.AvgScrMath) > 560;

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode)
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY cds
    HAVING AVG(AvgScrMath) > 560
) ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Charter';
